architecture_notes: Customer prefers AWS. Proposed topology: customer VPCs in us-east-1 + eu-west-1 with Redwood Private nodes deployed into customer subnets via CloudFormation/Terraform modules
Connectivity: prefer AWS PrivateLink endpoints for control-plane traffic and Transit Gateway for high-throughput inference egress to Redwood nodes; avoid cross-account VPC peering for scale
Inbound/Outbound: No public inbound allowed. Outbound to Redwood management endpoints must be restricted via VPC endpoints and egress NAT gateway; security requests egress proxy and allowlist only
Subnet design: isolated private subnets for inference nodes, dedicated management subnets for control plane endpoints, separate S3 endpoints for audit logs
KMS: customer requires CMKs in their AWS account with cross-account grants to Redwood service principal; option for HSM-backed keys for highest sensitivity customers
Audit logging: CloudTrail + VPC flow logs forwarded to customer S3 bucket and Kinesis for SIEM ingestion; retention policy 7 years for EU regulated data
Failover/regions: active-primary us-east-1 with active-standby eu-west-1 for EU-only tenants; automatic routing policy to ensure EU-resident prompts never leave eu-west-1
